certified_cases: exact optimum from residual cycle hitting
control: static permanent zero pins from time zero, all vertices eligible, unit cost, eventual convergence from every compatible initial state
main_run_rule: run only after independent engine validation passes; retain every draw and any adverse outcome
matching: uniform permutation of labeled output stubs into two ordered receiver slots; implementation may shuffle source-label multiset since every source sequence has the same labeled-stub multiplicity
pilot: timing only, separate seed namespace, at most 20 draws per representative size; no scientific outcomes used to change this protocol
planned_figures: cost distributions at the largest size, including degree-rule association contrasts
certificate failure probabilities versus size with binomial intervals
residual survival functions and first/second cost moments versus size
planned_validation: independent literal support iteration and full original-state exact control on small networks, repeated parents, zero output degree, seed replay, and work-cap handling
truth_tables: g00=0; g10,g01,g11 mutually independent conditional on fixed receiver types

uncertainty.cost_distribution: all-draw empirical CDF bounds; pointwise empirical PMF bounds where plotted
uncertainty.failure_probability: pointwise two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals including zero counts
uncertainty.interpretation: partial-identification intervals are distinct from sampling uncertainty; no finite-sample Poisson convergence rate is inferred
uncertainty.moments: all-draw raw first and second moment bounds; ordinary Monte Carlo standard errors only when all costs are resolved

uncertified_cases.search: pin subsets in increasing cardinality, exact finite functional graph
uncertified_cases.timing: no wall-time cutoff; deterministic budget and seed replay
uncertified_cases.work_unit_definition: one residual-row evaluation in successor-table construction or one controlled successor-edge traversal
